title: LIST CHANGED WHILE STILL IN USE
message:
`List.push` changes `values` in place, but `values` is read again afterwards.

3|    changed = List.push values 1
                ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ the list is changed in place here
4|    ( changed, values )
                 ^^^^^^ and `values` is read here, after the change

If the list were changed in place, `values` would see the change when it is read
on line 4.

To change a copy and leave `values` as it was, copy it there:

3|    changed = List.push (List.copy values) 1

This is sharing the checker can see: `values` is read on line 4, after the
change.
